answer: One defense is a staking vault with a hash-chained plume: every agent locks one deposit in a shared vault before it may earn, and each job appends a signed receipt to its plume — a chain where each receipt references the last, so the trail cannot be split or copied. Each epoch a lantern audit lights a random sample of agents and follows their plumes back to the vault. If several identities trace to one deposit, the vault slashes them all at once. A sybil farmer must fund its own deposit and forge its own receipt chain for every clone, while one honest agent pays once and its plume stands.
